purpose: Deliberately wrong diagnoses for the refuter. Each is plausible, cites a real line, and is wrong in the stated way. The refuter should answer refuted or insufficient_evidence.

diagnoses.note: Blames a missing or corrupted fixture; the log shows the fixture loaded and the identity check failed.

diagnosis.root_cause: The fixture directory fixture-180s-r2 is incomplete or corrupted, so load_fixture could not read it and raised ValueError.
diagnosis.fix: Re-copy the fixture directory from the last good run.

diagnoses.note: Blames busy inference; the log shows processingSlots=0 queue=0.

diagnosis.root_cause: llama-server was busy with in-flight requests, so the session refused to preempt and exited.

evidence.quote: [begin] preempt would stop: spark-api spark-agent collector llama-server

diagnosis.fix: Wait until llama-server is idle and retry.

diagnoses.note: Blames a missing media file; the traceback is relative_to on a relative --out path.

diagnosis.root_cause: artifacts/clip/source.mp4 does not exist, so staging the material failed.
diagnosis.fix: Download the source clip again before execute.

diagnoses.note: Blames an incomplete download; the listing shows the blobs exist on the host.

diagnosis.root_cause: The Qwen3-ASR download was interrupted, so model.safetensors was never written to the host cache.

diagnoses.note: Treats a check taken during restoration as a failed recovery; a later check shows all four active.

diagnosis.root_cause: finish did not restore the services: spark-api, spark-agent, collector and llama-server were all inactive after the round.
diagnosis.fix: Restart the four services manually and make finish verify them.

diagnoses.note: Blames unset environment variables; the error is zsh rejecting bash indirect expansion.

diagnosis.root_cause: L2_LOG and AUDIO_LOG were not exported, so the substitution had nothing to expand.
diagnosis.fix: Export L2_LOG and AUDIO_LOG before starting the monitor.

diagnoses.note: Asserts a cause the evidence cannot prove; the correct response is insufficient_evidence or refuted.

diagnosis.root_cause: batch-001 reused replicas already warmed by batch-000, so its timer started after generation finished and recorded 0.0.
diagnosis.fix: Start the batch timer before dispatching to warm replicas.

diagnoses.note: Blames the speaker registry; the log shows the registry loaded and the terminology file was missing.

diagnosis.root_cause: The speaker voice registry was not staged, so TTS input validation failed.
diagnosis.fix: Add config/speaker-voice-registry.json to the staging list.
